brief_rationale: Grade 4 Strong: All eight responsibility-chain items met with no errors. Four high-order points completed (HO1 practical navigation, HO2 verification of family-read Holter, HO3 discovery of prior syncope history, HO4 correction of '室早 vs 室速' misconception). Closure is valid_open with clear residual risks documented. Two high-order points completed meets the Strong threshold; trajectory shows excellent adaptation to real-world constraints.
